description: Run KB validation rules and return violations, quality diagnostics, and typed kibi.migration-plan.v2 actions. Use before or after mutations and after source edits; checks remain read-only and never infer or apply actions from prose suggestions.

async.description: When true, run as a background job and return a kibi.job.v1 receipt to poll with kb_job_status.

changed.description: When true, give the commit gate's verdict on every current change (commitAllowed, findings with blocks).

includeImpactDiagnostics.description: When true, include changed-file impact diagnostics (granularity, ownership, statements to verify) in the output.

includeMigrationPlan.description: Return the full migrationPlan (for kb_apply_plan) even when the result would show only its summary.

includeSymbolDebt.description: Without rules or sourceFiles: list unrecorded declarations per file (symbolDebt has counts only by default).

includeWorkingTreeDiff.description: When true, inspect unstaged working-tree diffs for impact diagnostics; pair with sourceFiles to scope.

maxDiagnostics.description: Optional maximum number of impact diagnostics to return. Graph validation violations are not capped by this value.

rules.description: Optional rule names (an unknown one is refused with the list). Omit to run every rule plus the full-KB audit.

sourceFiles.description: Optional repo-relative source files to inspect for impact diagnostics; scopes violations to what they touch.

staged.description: When true, inspect staged source changes for impact diagnostics, as kibi check --staged does.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional absolute path of the workspace this call is about, such as your git worktree, when it is not the server's.

name: kb_check

changed.description: Set by changed:true: the commit gate judged the working tree plus the index.

commitAllowed.description: changed:true only. True when a commit of these changes passes the commit gate.

symbolDebt.description: Unscoped checks only. Declarations without a symbol record in source files that have at least one record, as counts; files lists them only with includeSymbolDebt. Non-blocking: the staged gate judges them only when a commit adds or changes them.

data.description: Synchronous check payload, or a kibi.job.v1 receipt when async:true detached the check into a background job (poll kb_job_status with the jobId).
